name: Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man
description: Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man is a woody-spicy EDP for men. It opens with lemon, pineapple, and bergamot, moves into smoky birch with jasmine and rose, then dries down to musk, ambergris, and patchouli. A bold evening signature with strong projection.

name: Riiffs Goodness Oud Purple Wave
description: Riiffs Goodness Oud Purple Wave is an oriental EDP with a rum-and-raspberry opening, a saffron-cinnamon-tobacco heart, and a warm cedar, leather, and vanilla trail. Rich, sweet, and made for night wear.

name: Ajmal Bastion
description: Ajmal Bastion is a fresh woody EDP for men. Pineapple, lemon, and mandarin open the scent, clary sage and lavender sit in the heart, and cedarwood musk keeps it clean through the day.

name: Oud Arabia Jannat E Zuhur
description: Oud Arabia Jannat E Zuhur is a unisex floral parfum built around jasmine, Taif rose, and lily of the valley over amber, white musk, and Bulgarian rose. A garden-like trail with exceptional staying power.

name: Oud Arabia Zainab
description: Oud Arabia Zainab is a unisex parfum of vanilla oud, blueberry, and citrus over cashmere woods, then agarwood, honey, and amber. Fresh florals on a lasting musk-and-oud base.

name: Valentino Born in Roma
description: Valentino Born in Roma is a woody-aromatic EDT for men. Mineral salt and violet leaf open onto ginger and sage, then a vetiver-wood drydown. Modern, urban, and easy to wear all day.

name: French Avenue Liquid Brun
description: French Avenue Liquid Brun Eau de Parfum is a spicy amber-vanilla for men. Cinnamon, bergamot, and cardamom lead into bourbon vanilla and orange blossom, then praline, ambroxan, and guaiac wood. A sweet, loud evening scent.

name: Lattafa Khamrah
description: Lattafa Khamrah is a unisex oriental gourmand EDP. Cinnamon and nutmeg open onto dates, praline, and tuberose, then vanilla, tonka, and amberwood. Warm, sweet, and built for cooler evenings.

name: Lattafa Khamrah Qahwa
description: Lattafa Khamrah Qahwa is the coffee-spiced take on Khamrah. Cinnamon, cardamom, and ginger meet praline and candied fruit, then coffee, vanilla, and tonka. Unisex, sweet, and long-lasting.

name: Arabiyat Al Noor
description: Arabiyat Prestige Al Noor is a unisex EDP of cardamom, saffron, and nutmeg over iris, vetiver, and fig, finishing on vanilla, patchouli, and leather. Refined enough for day, warm enough for night.

name: Blue by Ahmed
description: Blue by Ahmed from Ahmed Al Maghribi is an aromatic woody EDP for men. Grapefruit, lemon, and mint open the scent, ginger and jasmine sit in the heart, and cedar, sandalwood, and incense close it. Clean, modern, and office-ready.

name: Prada L'Homme Eau de Toilette
description: Prada L'Homme Eau de Toilette is a powdery woody scent for men. Neroli and cardamom lead into iris, geranium, and violet, then cedar, sandalwood, and amber. Polished, clean, and made for the office.

name: Tom Ford Ombré Leather
description: Tom Ford Ombré Leather is a leather EDP for men. Cardamom opens onto smooth leather and jasmine sambac, then patchouli, moss, and amber. A desert-heat leather with presence after dark.

name: Chopard Oud Malaki Eau de Parfum
description: Chopard Oud Malaki Eau de Parfum is a woody oriental for men. Grapefruit and lavender open onto tobacco and leather, then royal oud and amber. Warm, smoky, and built for Gulf evenings.

name: Afnan 9PM
description: Afnan 9PM is an amber-vanilla EDP for men. Apple, cinnamon, and bergamot open onto orange blossom, then vanilla, tonka, and amber. A sweet night-out scent with strong longevity.

name: Lattafa Eclaire
description: Lattafa Eclaire is a gourmand EDP for women. Milk and sugar open onto honey and white flowers, then caramel, vanilla, and sandalwood. Creamy, sweet, and addictive on skin.

name: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You
description: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You is an amber-spicy EDT for men. Cardamom and pink pepper open onto sage and lavender, then vanilla and chestnut. Warm, slightly sweet, and easy for weekends.

name: Bleu de Chanel
description: Bleu de Chanel is an aromatic woody EDT for men. Lemon, mint, and pink pepper open onto ginger and jasmine, then incense, cedar, and sandalwood. A clean classic for any hour.

name: Elie Saab Le Parfum
description: Elie Saab Le Parfum is a floral oriental EDP for women. Orange blossom and jasmine open onto rose honey and patchouli, then cedar and rosewood. Luminous, elegant, and made for celebrations.

name: Rasasi Hawas
description: Rasasi Hawas is a fresh spicy EDP for men. Apple, bergamot, and cinnamon open onto orange blossom and cardamom, then ambergris, musk, and driftwood. Aquatic, sweet, and built for heat.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Eau de Parfum
description: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Eau de Parfum is an oriental floral for women. Blood orange and mandarin open onto honey and gardenia, then caramel, patchouli, and sandalwood. Sweet, bold, and unforgettable after dark.

name: Dior Sauvage Eau de Toilette
description: Dior Sauvage Eau de Toilette is an aromatic fresh scent for men. Bergamot and pepper open onto lavender, then ambroxan and cedar. A modern classic for heat and city wear.

name: Versace Eros Eau de Parfum
description: Versace Eros Eau de Parfum is a fresh oriental for men. Apple, lemon, and mint open onto tonka and ambroxan, then vanilla and cedar. Sweet, loud, and built for night.

name: Paco Rabanne Invictus
description: Paco Rabanne Invictus is a fresh aquatic EDT for men. Grapefruit and marine notes open onto bay leaf and jasmine, then guaiac wood and patchouli. Sporty and easy in the heat.

name: Lattafa Asad
description: Lattafa Asad is an oriental spicy EDP for men. Black pepper, tobacco, and pineapple open onto patchouli and coffee, then vanilla and amber. Dark, sweet, and long-lasting.

name: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb
description: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb is an oriental spicy EDT for men. Citrus and pink pepper open onto cinnamon and saffron, then tobacco, vetiver, and leather. Explosive spice for cooler nights.

name: Lattafa Yara
description: Lattafa Yara is a fruity floral EDP for women. Heliotrope, orchid, and tangerine open onto a gourmand heart, then vanilla, musk, and sandalwood. Soft, sweet, and everyday-ready.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Libre
description: Yves Saint Laurent Libre is a floral aromatic EDP for women. Lavender and mandarin open onto orange blossom and jasmine, then vanilla, musk, and cedar. Bold, luminous, and free.

name: Gucci Bloom Parfum
description: Gucci Bloom Parfum is a white floral for women. Jasmine and Rangoon creeper open onto tuberose, then sandalwood and musk. A garden in full bloom, concentrated.

name: Mugler Alien
description: Mugler Alien is a woody floral EDP for women. Jasmine sambac sits over cashmeran and white amber. Solar, intense, and famously long on skin.

name: Lattafa Khamrah Dukhan
description: Lattafa Khamrah Dukhan is the smoky chapter of Khamrah. Cinnamon and incense open onto dates and praline, then smoke, vanilla, and amberwood. Unisex, dark, and winter-ready.
